_about: Questions with hand-written gold SQL for the sample shop (seed_db.py). Gold queries follow config/shop.md: revenue counts only delivered and shipped orders. Written independently of the offline engine, in a different style (subqueries, CTEs, IN lists). kind: 'template' = a shape the offline engine is meant to cover, 'beyond' = needs the AI mode.

questions.question: What was total revenue in 2025?
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur), 2) FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND ordered_at LIKE '2025%')

questions.question: Revenue by category
questions.gold: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM categories cat JOIN products pr ON pr.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY cat.id

questions.question: Top 5 products by units sold in September 2026
questions.gold: SELECT pr.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS u FROM order_items oi JOIN products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2026-09') GROUP BY pr.id ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which city has the most customers?
questions.gold: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many orders came through the mobile app?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE channel = 'mobile_app'

questions.question: Monthly revenue
questions.gold: SELECT substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 7), ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Return rate by category
questions.gold: WITH oc AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.status, pr.category_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled') SELECT cat.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oc.status = 'returned') / COUNT(*), 2) FROM oc JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = oc.category_id GROUP BY cat.name

questions.question: Average order value by city
questions.gold: WITH t AS (SELECT o.id, cu.city, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur) AS total FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY o.id) SELECT city, ROUND(AVG(total), 2) FROM t GROUP BY city

questions.question: Top 10 customers by revenue
questions.gold: SELECT cu.first_name || ' ' || cu.last_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) AS r FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY cu.id ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Revenue by payment method
questions.gold: SELECT pay.method, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM payments pay JOIN orders o ON o.id = pay.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY pay.method

questions.question: How many new customers signed up each month?
questions.gold: SELECT substr(signed_up, 1, 7), COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Gross profit by category in Q1 2026
questions.gold: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur) - SUM(oi.quantity * pr.cost_eur), 2) FROM categories cat JOIN products pr ON pr.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND date(o.ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31' GROUP BY cat.name

questions.question: How many cancelled orders were there?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

questions.question: Revenue from Laptops in Sofia
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE cu.city = 'Sofia' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND oi.product_id IN (SELECT pr.id FROM products pr JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = pr.category_id WHERE cat.name = 'Laptops')

questions.question: Revenue in Plovdiv in the last 30 days
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE cu.city = 'Plovdiv' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.ordered_at >= date((SELECT MAX(ordered_at) FROM orders), '-30 days')

questions.question: What is the best-selling product?
questions.gold: SELECT pr.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS u FROM order_items oi JOIN products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY pr.id ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Units in stock by category
questions.gold: SELECT cat.name, (SELECT SUM(stock) FROM products pr WHERE pr.category_id = cat.id) FROM categories cat

questions.question: Margin by category
questions.gold: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(100.0 * (1 - SUM(oi.quantity * pr.cost_eur) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur)), 1) FROM categories cat JOIN products pr ON pr.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY cat.name

questions.question: How many customers placed an order in October 2026?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE ordered_at LIKE '2026-10%'

questions.question: Number of orders per channel each month
questions.gold: SELECT substr(ordered_at, 1, 7), channel, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1, 2

questions.question: How many orders per city?
questions.gold: SELECT cu.city, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY cu.city

questions.question: Total units sold by category in 2026
questions.gold: SELECT cat.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM categories cat JOIN products pr ON pr.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY cat.name

questions.question: What is the average order value?
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur) AS t FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY o.id)

questions.question: Return rate per channel
questions.gold: SELECT channel, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status = 'returned') / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY channel

questions.question: Phones revenue by month
questions.gold: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at), ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = pr.category_id WHERE cat.name = 'Phones' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Which payment method is used most?
questions.gold: SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments GROUP BY method ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Sales in Varna by year
questions.gold: SELECT substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 4), ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE cu.city = 'Varna' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How much revenue came from cash on delivery orders in 2026?
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.ordered_at LIKE '2026%' AND o.id IN (SELECT order_id FROM payments WHERE method = 'cash_on_delivery')

questions.question: Bottom 3 categories by revenue
questions.gold: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) AS r FROM categories cat JOIN products pr ON pr.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY r ASC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Gross profit in 2025
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price_eur - pr.cost_eur)), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.ordered_at) = '2025'

questions.question: Revenue by category in Burgass
questions.gold: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM categories cat JOIN products pr ON pr.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE cu.city = 'Burgas' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY cat.name

questions.question: How many products do we sell?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

questions.question: How many orders were returned in 2026?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned' AND ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

questions.question: Revenue from website orders in March 2026
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND substr(o.ordered_at, 1, 7) = '2026-03'

questions.question: Which category has the highest margin?
questions.gold: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price_eur - pr.cost_eur)) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 1) AS m FROM categories cat JOIN products pr ON pr.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY m DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Orders and revenue by channel
questions.gold: SELECT o.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY o.channel

questions.question: Which customers have never placed an order?
questions.gold: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

questions.question: What share of revenue comes from Laptops?
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cat.name = 'Laptops' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur END) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 1) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = pr.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')

questions.question: Which products sold fewer than 5 units in October 2026?
questions.gold: SELECT pr.name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS u FROM products pr LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.id AND oi.order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE ordered_at LIKE '2026-10%' AND status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')) GROUP BY pr.id HAVING u < 5

questions.question: How many customers ordered more than once?
questions.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

questions.question: Average number of items per order
questions.gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

questions.question: Compare revenue between web and mobile app in 2026
questions.gold: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_eur), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.ordered_at LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY o.channel
